statement: For the Sp4 diagonal D (u1=5,u2=3 at N=53) and the D-fixed character coset P: ||P U_D T(n) P||_F^2 = 1 if n is in the position sector (n3=n4=0) and = 0 otherwise — EXACTLY, over all sampled mixed n.  The coset sees only the position translations, with zero fluctuation within the sector.
why: coset characters are D-fixed: <chi|U_D T(n)|chi> = <chi|T(n)|chi> = e(phase) * sum_x e_N(k n1 + l n2), and the coset sum over chi kills all n with momentum components.
significance: the G0 flatness at rank 2 is EXACT and structural (stronger than the rank-1 flat+Weil): the coset decomposes the kernel space into an exactly-flat sector and an orthogonal sector. The cat-map's Weil correction at rank 1 comes from the (x-1) twist; the Sp4 diagonal has no such twist — its flatness is exact.
